citation.text_span: Reference: SN-2026-0101
Northbridge Capital Markets (Canada) Inc. (the "Issuer") will issue notes
in an aggregate Notional Amount of USD 5,000,000
an aggregate Notional Amount of USD 5,000,000
The Trade Date is 14 April 2026
the Issue Date is 21 April 2026
the Scheduled Maturity Date is 23 April 2029
linked to the performance of the S&P 500 Index (Bloomberg: SPX Index)
The Initial Level of each Underlying is 100% of its official closing level on the Trade Date.
a knock-in barrier observed on the Final Valuation Date only (European observation)
at a Knock-in Level of 65% of the Initial Level
a conditional Coupon of 7.5% per annum, payable quarterly
a conditional Coupon of 7.5% per annum
7.5% per annum, payable quarterly
No memory feature: a Coupon that is not paid because the Coupon Condition is not satisfied on the relevant Coupon Observation Date is forfeited and will not be paid at a later date.
Autocall Observation Dates: 14 April 2027, 14 October 2027, 14 April 2028, 16 October 2028.
if on any Autocall Observation Date the closing level of the Underlying is at or above 100% of the Initial Level
Coupon amounts accrue on a 30/360 day count basis.
Settlement at maturity or upon early redemption is in cash, in USD.
Payment dates are adjusted in accordance with the Modified Following Business Day Convention.
